concerns.text: Spec FR-008 mandates the human‑coding script be named `04_human_coding.py`. The task list implements the protocol in `code/human_coding.py` (and related test scripts), which weakens the functional requirement by changing the required artifact name.

SC‑001 requires verification that the RMS‑contrast change for each manipulated image is ≥ 15 % relative to the original. No task explicitly measures or asserts this threshold; T017 only checks CLIP similarity and texture/edge changes, leaving the RMS‑contrast criterion untested.

SC‑004 calls for reporting the proportion of valid participants (after straight‑liner exclusion) against the total recruited sample. T045 removes straight‑liners but never computes or outputs the valid‑participant ratio, thus dropping an acceptance criterion.

FR‑006 specifies that effect sizes must be calculated using Type III Sums of Squares (or an equivalent method) for the CLMM. T035 only computes odds ratios and confidence intervals without performing a Type III SS analysis, weakening the required statistical reporting.
